_comment: The one list of go-common consumers for .github/workflows/bump-consumers.yml. Per entry: repo (short name in the org), module_dir (directory of the go.mod, relative to the repo root), enabled (default true; false = open nothing, give the reason in note), auto_merge (default true; false = open the PR but never switch on auto-merge), required_checks (check names that must be REQUIRED on main before auto-merge is switched on: the repo's test jobs, as GitHub shows them), deploy_workflow (default deploy.yml: the workflow whose run on the merge commit the job waits for; "" = the repo has no deploy workflow, the job ends once the PR is merged). Edit this file to add or retire a consumer; nothing else lists them.

consumers.note: OPEN NOTHING: geo-service is still on the go-common of 04.11.2026, before release 2 (events.NewDispatcher needs a deduplicator and a group, outbox.New needs a key-hashing writer, ...). A bump there does not compile. Port it by hand, then delete this flag.

The translation catalogue (validator + ConfigMap appliers). It has no deploy workflow: apply-configmap runs only for *.json changes and a bump touches go.mod / go.sum. Its validator runs against the PINNED go-common, so the PR's `validate` check is the real test. The repo has auto-merge switched off in its settings today: the PR opens and waits for a human until that is turned on.

tools/dlqctl (the DLQ CLI) pinned go-common of 27.07.2026. It imports only pkg/envelope (HeaderEventType, HeaderRetryCount), pkg/events (ValidTopicName) and pkg/kafkaauth (Transport), all still present, so the bump plausibly compiles; its PR check `test (tools/dlqctl) / build & test` decides. dev-setup is the orchestration repo: main has no branch protection and auto-merge is off in its settings, so auto_merge stays false and an owner merges the PR. Nothing deploys from a merge here. Only tools/dlqctl is listed: loops/loopctl and tools/egressprobe do not import go-common.
PHP repo; its Go module is the outbox relay. The bump touches services/outbox-worker/go.mod and go.sum only. validate is the PHP suite and runs on every PR.
